about.title: Who we are
about.subtitle: Discover Tanur's Legacy
about.text1: The Tanur Heritage is a cultural and historical program aimed at unveiling the rich history and vibrant traditions of Tanur, a coastal town in Kerala. The initiative brings together historians, scholars, and the local community to celebrate and explore Tanur's diverse cultural past, including its ancient maritime trade connections, historical landmarks, and unique traditions.
about.text2: Through exhibitions, talks, and cultural performances, Tanur Heritage highlights the town's role in Kerala's historical narrative, showcasing its contributions to art, religion, and trade. The program seeks to preserve and promote awareness of Tanur's heritage for future generations.
paragraphs: The Tanur Heritage is a cultural and historical program aimed at unveiling the rich history and vibrant traditions of Tanur, a coastal town in Kerala. The initiative brings together historians, scholars, and the local community to celebrate and explore Tanur's diverse cultural past, including its ancient maritime trade connections, historical landmarks, and unique traditions.

Through exhibitions, talks, and cultural performances, Tanur Heritage highlights the town's role in Kerala's historical narrative, showcasing its contributions to art, religion, and trade. The program seeks to preserve and promote awareness of Tanur's heritage for future generations.

events.title: Heritage Carnival
events.description: Get ready to uncover Tanur's hidden gems! Join the Heritage Carnival on Oct 19-20, 2024, for an immersive experience of traditional art, food, and craft workshops. Discover the region's fascinating history and cultural significance.

events.title: Heritage Walk
events.description: Join us for a guided tour of Tanur's historic landmarks, cultural centers, and esteemed institutions. This heritage walk unveils the town's rich cultural tapestry, showcasing traditional monuments, architectural marvels, and community hubs.

events.title: Photography Award
events.description: Enter our Heritage Photography Award contest! Capture the essence of cultural and historical landmarks, traditions, and artifacts. Submit your best shots by 18 October 2024. Winner receives the coveted Heritage Photography Award!
